patches.title: Liquidify · Glass navigation
patches.description: AndroidLiquidGlass navigation, mini-player and runtime design settings. Keeps native TIDAL routes and actions. Requires Liquidify Manager 1.1.1-beta.1.

patches.title: Liquidify · Design and gestures
patches.description: Anchored Liquid Glass Output popup with native TIDAL devices and an integrated Linn OpenHome provider. Device-side TIDAL queue, central playback adapter, remote volume and reconnect. Requires TIDAL sign-in for the renderer through the Linn app. Beta; see LINN_OUTPUT.md for tested scope.

patches.title: Liquidify · Typography
patches.description: Static Inter font instances, with original labels and accessibility text retained.

patches.title: Enable Legacy UI
patches.description: [This patch will stop working soon] - Replaces the New Compose based UI with the Legacy UI (disables player-market-ui feature flag)

patches.title: Radiant Lyrics API - WIP
patches.description: Use Radiant Lyrics API to fetch Lyrics (Syllable Level & Higher Quality)

advancedOptions.title: Romanization
advancedOptions.description: Return a romanized transcription and show that instead of the original script

advancedOptions.title: WIP | AI Generate Syllables
advancedOptions.description: [Only works with API results] - Generates Syllable timings from Line timings using a self trained AI model

advancedOptions.title: Context Aware Lyrics
advancedOptions.description: Display voice context cues (adlibs and duet singers get displayed seperately)

patches.title: Player Backdrop
patches.description: Swap the player backdrop for the Kawarp shader, or fine-tune TIDAL's own blurred cover

advancedOptions.title: Blur Strength
advancedOptions.description: The value of Blur applied to the backdrop cover

advancedOptions.title: Contrast
advancedOptions.description: The value of Contrast applied to the backdrop cover

advancedOptions.title: Saturation
advancedOptions.description: The value of Saturation applied to the backdrop cover

advancedOptions.title: Brightness
advancedOptions.description: The value of Brightness applied to the backdrop cover

advancedOptions.title: Playback Reactive
advancedOptions.description: Cover shader reacts to playback state by freezing/resuming

advancedOptions.title: Blur Passes
advancedOptions.description: Kawase blur passes, higher is softer but costs more GPU

advancedOptions.title: Warp Intensity
advancedOptions.description: Strength of the fluidity effect

advancedOptions.title: Animation Speed
advancedOptions.description: How fast the backdrop flows

advancedOptions.title: Backdrop Scale
advancedOptions.description: Zoom level of the effect

advancedOptions.title: Contrast
advancedOptions.description: Contrast of the backdrop

advancedOptions.title: Saturation
advancedOptions.description: Colour intensity of the backdrop

advancedOptions.title: Brightness
advancedOptions.description: The value of Brightness applied to the backdrop

advancedOptions.title: Auto Darken Bright Covers
advancedOptions.description: Prevents bright covers from making text unreadable

advancedOptions.title: Dithering
advancedOptions.description: Breaks up color banding in smooth gradients

advancedOptions.title: Cover Everywhere - WIP
advancedOptions.description: Applies TIDAL's native blurred album-art backdrop to every Compose based page (Home & Collection)

patches.title: Quality Badge Colors
patches.description: Brings color back to the player quality badge.

patches.title: Playing From
patches.description: Shows the source name (playlist/album/mix) above the track title

patches.title: One-Handed Mode
patches.description: Mirrors the bottom player buttons left-to-right for easier one-handed reach.

patches.title: Swipe to Queue
patches.description: Swipe on tracks/albums/playlists to add them to the play queue (and more actions)

patches.title: Lyrics Progress Pill
patches.description: Restores the old Track Progress Pill in the top of the Lyrics screen!

patches.title: Disable Lyrics Cover
patches.description: Removes the mini track cover from the lyrics screen.

patches.title: Replace Lyrics Button
patches.description: Replaces the Lyrics button with the RL Sparkle!

patches.title: Replace Share Button
patches.description: Replaces the share button with the Tidal Connect button from the top of the screen. (it's in the menu already)

patches.title: Redesigned Mini-Player
patches.description: Integrates the Seekbar into the control panel at the bottom of the screen.

advancedOptions.title: Mini-Player Dynamic Background
advancedOptions.description: Colorizes the Mini-Player depending on the currently playing track.

advancedOptions.title: Progress Border
advancedOptions.description: Draws an animated progress ring around the floating mini-player. Requires the Floating style.

advancedOptions.title: Mini-Player Gestures
advancedOptions.description: Adds swipe up gesture to the mini-player to reopen the player

advancedOptions.title: Next/Previous Gestures
advancedOptions.description: Swipe left or right on the mini-player to skip tracks.

patches.title: Keep Controls Visible
patches.description: Inverts the auto-hide behavior on the lyrics screen, playback controls stay visible by default and only hide when you tap them off. Also stops the open lyrics view from randomly closing when the player re-fetches the same track.

patches.title: Waze Integration
patches.description: Control TIDAL playback from the Waze app

patches.title: Pebble Watch
patches.description: Shows synced lyrics on your Pebble Time 2 when listening, Everything is configured and managed in the Pebble App

patches.title: Unlock Debug Menu
patches.description: Reveals TIDAL's hidden Debug Menu in Settings. (Unlocks Feature Flags & the legacy Debug Options)
